_meta.source: Google Stitch export 'Game Simulator' (7 PNG screens: Beranda, Peristiwa dan Keputusan, Statistik pemerintahan, Laporan Hasil Kuartal, Profil presiden, Pengaturan permainan, Login) refined for desktop clarity and low visual clutter.
_meta.how_to_update: Edit values here; StitchTheme builds the Godot Theme from this file at startup. No Godot code change is needed for palette, outline, radius or depth changes.
_meta.font: Bree Serif for major headings; Alegreya Sans Medium/Bold for body, controls, small headings and numbers. Two active font families; SIL OFL.
_meta.runtime_integration: 2026-11-15; preserve real GIS geometry and live simulation values instead of prototype fixtures.
_meta.direction: User-directed tactile game UI using original Kenney Adventure CC0 sprites, concise map HUD, and optional data inspection.
